title: hf CLI failure-mode diagnostic scaffold (art_01M6V3QCJ14FJA43G1632JNGJS r1)

Covers the five failure modes listed in art_01M6V3QCJ14FJA43G1632JNGJS r1 — command not found, 401/gated, timeout, pattern mismatch, wrong revision — each with a minimal reproducing command and an expected observable symptom.
